title: Ad system repair and model config upkeep
summary:
A maintenance day: repaired ad-system plumbing, updated model configuration, and retired 53 tests from a previous geological era.

Fixed a critical issue in the ad system and refreshed model configurations, keeping the surrounding infrastructure behaving as intended.

Removed 53 obsolete test files across services, clearing out stale coverage that no longer matched the codebase.

highlights.title: Hybrid Image Model
highlights.text: Upgraded image generation to use BPAIGen (1216px) as the primary engine with Kontext fallback for higher quality results. [Image API](https://image.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: OpenAPI Spec
highlights.text: Added official OpenAPI specification for the Image API to help developers build integrations faster. [API Docs](https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/docs)
